title: thinopyrum × duvalii
intro: Thinopyrum × duvalii, commonly known as thick-spiked wheat grass or false brome, is a hybrid of the Thinopyrum intermedium and Pascopyrum smithii plants. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Thinopyrum × duvalii include its ability to act as an immunomodulator, modulating the immune system and promoting its balance, as well as its potential as an anti-diabetic agent, helping to regulate blood sugar levels. The bioactive constituents of Thinopyrum × duvalii include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
